content.title: Book Platinum Member Airfares | American Express Travel
content.text: Log in and Explore All Fares, Including Platinum Member AirfaresSave When You FlyEnjoy savings on select premium tickets booked through Amex Travel with participating airlines on designated international flights. Plus, enjoy savings on select economy tickets with limited participating airlines on domestic flights through Amex Travel. American Express Travel® does not charge booking fees.Earn 5X Membership Rewards® Points 2,3Platinum Card® Members earn 5X points2 on up to $500,000 per calendar year on flights purchased directly from airlines or American Express Travel®. Business Platinum Card® Members earn 5X points3 on flights booked at AmexTravel.com when you pay with your Business Platinum Card® Earn Airline Loyalty PointsEarn airline miles on bookings through American Express Travel as you typically would when booking direct. Must provide airline loyalty number when booking through Amex Travel™. Airline loyalty program rules apply and are subject to change.Savings You Can SharePlatinum Member Airfares offers savings for you and up to 7 companions on select tickets with participating airlines on designated flights when booked through American Express Travel®. Designed for you and those who travel alongside you. Eligible Card Member must be traveling on the itinerary.Platinum Member Airfares Partner Spotlight: Delta Air Lines Premium Select Enjoy savings on select premium tickets with Delta on designated international flights through Amex Travel™ with Platinum Member Airfares™. Put your feet up - really. Delta Premium Select seats feature a fold-out adjustable footrest and leg rest, so you've got space to stretch out. Enjoy an elevated meal service complete with complimentary wine, beer, and spirits. Must be 21+ to drink alcohol. Please drink responsibly. Enjoy a self-care moment with a premium amenity kit from Someone Somewhere, filled with essentials like an eye mask and lip balm from Grown Alchemist. Curl up with a memory-foam pillow, a plush blanket and noise-cancelling headphones, so that you can arrive at your destination well rested and refreshed. With more room to stretch out and premium amenities designed with your wellbeing in mind, you'll arrive refreshed and recharged. Lufthansa Allegris* Business Class Lufthansa Allegris offers more flexibility, comfort and privacy in all travel classes. In Business Class, choose from five unique seating options: the Extra Space Seat, the Extra Long Bed, the Privacy Seat, the Suite, or the Classic Seat. Each seat offers elevated features, such as individual seat heating and cooling, a control tablet, and wireless charging for ease and comfort.Enjoy 27-inch 4K screens and noise-cancelling headphones for the optimal entertainment experience during your flight. Whichever option you choose, Lufthansa Allegris allows you to tailor your trip exactly to your own wishes and needs. *Limited availability on select routes. More routes coming soon.
